title: WASM ABI: serialization format for game state
description: What's the exact serialization format for passing game state to/from WASM modules? Candidates: JSON (matches schema format, zero-dependency), Flatbuffers (fast, zero-copy), custom binary. JSON is the default candidate since we chose JSON for the schema. But WASM hot paths (legal move generation, complex scoring) may need something faster. Trade-off: simplicity vs. performance.
close_reason: JSON. Already implemented in wasm.rs. Matches schema, universal, fast enough. Optimize to binary ABI only if profiling shows need.
